policy: Rights-first. The repository records exact historical source editions. A public-domain source edition is still subject to jurisdiction review before commercial redistribution.

rules: Every record must ultimately exist in Hindi, English, Arabic and Urdu.
Translate the complete source story, never a summary or an unrelated retelling.
Preserve every event, action, character relationship, setting, object, number, dialogue, moral lesson and outcome.
Preserve the order in which evidence, consequences and lessons are revealed.
Do not add a moral that the source does not state and do not remove an explicit source lesson.
Preserve culturally specific terms and animal, religious or social roles without replacing them with unrelated target-culture concepts.
Where the source is a historical English translation of an older Sanskrit, Buddhist or Eastern work, label that lineage; do not claim the English source is the original-language text.
Do not convert traditional, religious or legendary material into scientific fact.
